name: Arabelle
summary: Arabelle brings together refined fabric upholstery and the strength of sculptural metal. The seat is wrapped in soft, textured fabric that feels both inviting and tailored, while the base in brushed bronze or brushed nickel offers a subtle gleam that anchors the design. With its clean lines and timeless proportions, it carries an understated elegance that elevates any interior with quiet confidence. 61x61x77
